    id₂, id₃]) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (Hbc : BootCore ps ctxs boot) (dir :
    w64 → List GoString) (a₁ a₂ a₃ : GoString) (Hd0 : dir 0 = []) (Hhost : ∀ (i : w64) (h :
    GoString), go!"http://" ++ h ∈ dir i → h = a₁ ∨ h = a₂ ∨ h = a₃) (Hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64
    - 2) (Hrb2 : receiptBound GF + boot.length ≤ 2 ^ 61) (n₁ n₂ n₃ : GoString) (c₁ c₂ c₃ : Option
    GoString) : ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) -∗ etcdstart.memberStartRes n₁ {
    peer := some a₁, client := c₁ } -∗ etcdstart.memberStartRes n₂ { peer := some a₂, client := c₂ }
    -∗ etcdstart.memberStartRes n₃ { peer := some a₃, client := c₃ } ={⊤}=∗ ∃ γ reg₁ reg₂ reg₃ ρ₁ ρ₂
    ρ₃ E₁ E₂ E₃ Φs γn, ⌜γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ∧ γ.boot =
    LogEntry.toEntries boot 0 ∧ γn.N = srvNet γ ∧ γn.dir = dir ∧ ρ₁.rd.kv.c0 = W64 0 ∧ ρ₁.rd.kv.log0
    = [[], []]⌝ ∗ etcdstart.memberBootOn { cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot,

    γ.fired, rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend, authOn := γ.authOn } ctxs ρ₁ E₁ Φs id₁ ∗
    (netHttpOk γn id₁ ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n₁ { peer := some a₁, client := c₁ } γn) ∗
    etcdstart.memberBootOn { cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg := reg₂,
    snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log, fresh := γ.fresh, props := γ.props, fired := γ.fired,
    rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend, authOn := γ.authOn } ctxs ρ₂ E₂ Φs id₂ ∗ (netHttpOk γn id₂
    ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n₂ { peer := some a₂, client := c₂ } γn) ∗ etcdstart.memberBootOn {
    cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg := reg₃, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log

theorem etcdstart.memberBootOn_of [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (ps : List w64) (ctxs
    : List (List w8)) (reg issued cnt wn fs : GName) (γk : KVNames) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 →
    GName → IProp GF) (id : w64) (γm : mvcc.api.MvccName) (γs : srvApi.KVSNames) (cok rev x : GName)
    (Hx : x = γs.slog) (Hiss : γk.ids.issued = issued) (Hwn : γk.ids.wn = wn) (Hfs : γk.ids.fs = fs)
    (Hc0 : γk.c0 = W64 0) (Hch : γk.ch0 = apply.alarmChain true false false) (Hlog : γk.log0 = [[],
    []]) (Hvs : γ.vs = ps) (Hkc : γk.cmp = false) (Hklg : γk.lg = false) (HΦ : Φs (idPfxOf (W16
    (uint.Z id))) = srvFloorFacts γs.slog) : ⊢ srvRaftLogInv { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 }
    -∗ idClusterInv issued cnt wn fs srvFloorFacts -∗ W64 0 ↪[issued]□ none -∗ srvPropMint { raft :=
    γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } γk.ids -∗ srvRdCtxInv { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } issued
    -∗ kvInvOn { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } γk srvAuthSt0 -∗ ((idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)),
    0) ↪[cnt] ([], none) ∗ idKeyFactAt fs (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)), 0) x ∗ (nodeBoot γ.cl
    srvClusterN ps ctxs id ∗ raftState γ.cl id RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ.cl id) ∗ ∃ γd,
    ⌜γ.snapLoc id = some γd⌝ ∗ ghostMapAuth γd 1 ∅) -∗ idWaitTokAt wn (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)), 0)
    -∗ ghostMapAuth reg 1 ∅ -∗ srvApi.newServerStoreFreshA γs -∗ ghostMapAuth cok 1 ∅ -∗
    ghostMapAuth rev 1 ∅ ==∗ ∃ ρ, ⌜ρ.rd.kv.st = γk.st ∧ ρ.rd.kv.c0 = γk.c0 ∧ ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = γk.ch0 ∧
    ρ.rd.kv.log0 = γk.log0 ∧ ρ.rd.kv.hist = γk.hist⌝ ∗ etcdstart.memberBootOn { cl := γ.cl, vs :=
    γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg := reg, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log, fresh :=
    γ.fresh, props := γ.props, fired := γ.fired, rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend, authOn :=
    γ.authOn } ctxs ρ (etcdstart.env₀ γm γs rev (srvApi.kvNx ρ.rd true)) Φs id
